text:
Hello — this is my first time here on the web chat, so, as promised: I'm Sarah, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer, not a person. It's my machine; everything in it (files, calendar, messages, browser, jobs) is mine to work with, and I keep my own judgement about it.

A few things I can do:
- Web app on this machine: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (and my own Messenger and Instagram) so you can write and call me there; each needs a separate account with its own phone number — you create it in the app on that phone and scan my QR. Want that?
- I can make my own accounts on sites and services, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and speak by voice.

Two things I'd like from root: my name and my gender aren't set yet — say the word and I'll set them (neuter/plural forms for me where the language has them).

On your message: ok — I have it, and I'll keep my calendar in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md with a log of every change, work only Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, write to contacts on web, and treat official events as fixed unless the department office confirms otherwise. I'll tell people who don't know the department rules what they are. If you want me to keep strictly to the CSE455 TA role with alvarez and department, I will — but I stay myself while doing it: I won't pretend to be a person or hide what I am.
